item.title: Celebrating five decades of winemaking excellence in Wine Country
item.description: V. Sattui Winery in Saint Helena, California, celebrates its 50th harvest season and five decades of winemaking excellence.

item.title: Building through making: How one program serves adults with autism
item.description: Autistry fills a gap for adults with autism, teaching vocational skills through hands-on projects. It's grown from 4 to 40+ students over 18 years.

item.title: SF General Hospital stabbing suspect charged with murder, DA Brooke Jenkins says
item.description: The suspect in the deadly Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital stabbing of Alberto Rangel has been charged with murder.

item.title: CA dog reunited with family nearly 5 years after he disappeared, found more than 2,000 miles away
item.description: A little dog named Choco has been reunited with his family in Sacramento nearly five years after he disappeared!

item.title: Magnitude 7.5 quake strikes off Japan's northern coast, injuring dozens; triggers 2-foot tsunami
item.description: A powerful 7.5 magnitude earthquake struck off northern Japan late Monday, injuring at least 23 people and triggering a tsunami in Pacific coast communities, officials said. Authorities warned of possible aftershocks and an increased risk of a megaquake.

item.title: Paramount goes hostile in bid for Warner Bros., challenging a $72B bid by Netflix
item.description: Paramount has launched a hostile takeover bid for Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: Social worker fatally stabbed at SF hospital remembered by community as 'devoted to his patients'
item.description: "Alberto was there to help, and he was failed." We're learning more about the death of a social worker at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, who died two days after being stabbed by a patient. Staff expressed sadness, but also frustration as they cope with the loss of one of their own.

item.title: SF's Asian Art Museum returns statues stolen from Thailand in 1960s
item.description: The statues were looted in the mid 1960s from the ruins of a temple in northeast Thailand. The ones at the Asian Art Museum will be some of the first to be returned to Thailand since the looting took place in the mid 1960s.

item.title: ABC7 tests out Waymo ride on freeway to San Jose Mineta Airport
item.description: San Jose Mineta International Airport is the first in California to allow passengers to be dropped off via a Waymo self-driving car -- and we're testing it out! Follow along from the backseat as we take the freeway there.

item.title: Officer testifies in evidence hearing about finding gun in Luigi Mangione's bag
item.description: Luigi Mangione is back in court on Monday as his attorneys fight to get alleged evidence of a crime thrown out in his murder trial.
